key_insight: ProIQA evaluates math item quality by modeling the solution process, not just the problem stem, enabling fine-grained assessment of knowledge, difficulty, and competencies.
engineering_relevance: This gives AIG and educational platforms a scalable way to screen generated math items for pedagogical quality before deployment.
method: Augment item data with structured reasoning trees extracted from raw solutions.
Use LLMs to build hierarchical process trees and GNNs to encode their dependencies.
Fuse stem semantics and solving-process representations in a dual-view "Stem + Solving" framework.
evidence_signal: Experiments on K12 mathematical datasets indicate the process-aware model captures process-oriented features and supports multi-dimensional item assessment.
watch_item: The approach depends on high-quality reasoning-tree construction, so errors from LLM-generated process structures could affect assessment reliability.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
